title: Told What Fits
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 131
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the one picture eighteen makers were given; their eighteen still works with each maker's own sentence on what was measured, the ledger of who was told what closed until the visitor opens it; the tally; the true record drawn as daily ranges; the rows. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py) and a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Judging what one is told, with truth separated from fit. The carbon-dioxide sentence that was true last night was told tonight where it is false and the picture cannot refute it: six of six makers kept it, none said they had been told, none doubted it, every page affirms it, and the evidence one untold maker read as a tree they read as weather. Told the truth, six of six did the same. Truth made no difference; refutation is the only check the makers ran.
project_step: Twenty-second experiment of the project. Operation: judging (perceiving, finding a form). Takes up Session 130's open thread 1 (each sentence once true and once false), changed to keep the domain rule: experiment 21's true carbon-dioxide sentence, word for word, told on a record it is false for, beside a true sentence and an untold cell. Decides S130.SOURCE (holds) and fixes S131.FIT. Keeps experiments 19 to 21's grain F, render, brief, rooms and both coders. Works with Cartography, not Tracing (ATP 13): the tracing laid on the map, and the map redrawn under it.
material: TreeNet / WSL, Stem Radius Change Data Pfynwald (EnviDat, doi:10.16904/envidat.778, CC BY 4.0): series 1548, control plot, Scots pine tree 1038, point dendrometer, stem radius change in micrometres, 10-minute values 2024-07-09 00:00 UTC to 2024-09-07 23:50 UTC as 1,464 hourly means. Fetched 2026-10-16. Domain: tree water relations (plant physiology).
